description: This script generates a build stamp file containing build timestamp and current Git commit hash. It includes functions to resolve the current Git HEAD and to write the build information to a file in the 'dist' directory, and executes automatically if run directly.

methods.name: resolveGitHead
methods.description: Resolves the current Git HEAD commit hash by running 'git rev-parse HEAD' in the specified directory.

methods.name: writeBuildStamp
methods.description: Creates a build stamp file under 'dist/.buildstamp' containing the build timestamp and Git HEAD hash.
